recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, salt
Flour tortillas, salsa, sour cream, cilantro
steps: Toss chicken with oil, spices, salt, and half the lime.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Cook peppers and onion in the same pan until charred-tender.
Return chicken, splash remaining lime, and pile into warm tortillas.
Kids plate: pasta with butter, fruit on the side. Skip the peppers if they push back.

recipes.name: Homemade pizza
ingredients: Toppings: pepperoni or leftover chicken, peppers, red onion
steps: Heat oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside.
Stretch dough, oil the hot pan, and lay dough on it.
Sauce, cheese, toppings. Keep one pizza cheese-only for the kids.
Bake 12–15 minutes until the edges blister.
Fruit bowl on the table so kids can graze while it cools.

recipes.name: Carne asada bowls
ingredients: Juice of 3 limes, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, salt, pepper
steps: Marinate steak 20+ minutes in lime, garlic, cumin, salt, and a little oil.
Grill or broil on high, 3–5 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes, slice thin.
Build bowls: rice, beans, steak, salsa, avocado, cilantro.
Kids plate: nuggets in the oven while the steak rests, fruit on the side.

recipes.name: Roast chicken + potatoes
ingredients: Olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken dry. Season all over. Stuff with lemon.
Toss potatoes with oil and salt on the same sheet around the chicken.
Roast 60–70 minutes until juices run clear (165°F in the thigh).
Rest 10 minutes. Eat early so you can make the 4pm game.
Kids plate: pasta with butter and parmesan, fruit cup. Save extra chicken for quesadillas.

recipes.name: Baked ziti
ingredients: 1 jar marinara plus a splash of water
French bread + butter for garlic bread
steps: Boil pasta 2 minutes under. Drain.
Stir ricotta with egg, garlic, salt, half the parmesan.
Fold pasta with marinara and ricotta. Layer in a baking dish with mozzarella.
Bake 20–25 minutes at 375°F until bubbly. Broil 1 minute if you want browned spots.
Garlic bread in the oven for the last 8 minutes. Kids usually eat this as-is.

recipes.name: Chicken quesadillas
ingredients: 3 cups shredded leftover roast chicken (or rotisserie)
steps: Warm chicken with a pinch of taco seasoning and a splash of salsa.
Cheese + chicken in tortillas. Press in a dry skillet until both sides are golden.
Make at least two cheese-only quesadillas for the kids.
Cut into triangles. Fruit and a little sour cream on the side.

recipes.name: Turkey taco skillet
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper. Drain if needed.
Stir in seasoning, beans, and salsa. Simmer 8 minutes.
Top with cheese to melt. Scoop over chips or rice.
Kids plate: nuggets + apple slices. Offer a tiny scoop of turkey if they’re curious.

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken + rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp minced garlic, splash of water
Green onions, sesame seeds if you have them
steps: Start the rice. Steam or microwave broccoli.
Sear chicken thighs until browned and cooked through. Slice.
Pour soy, honey, garlic, and a splash of water into the pan. Bubble until glossy. Toss chicken.
Serve over rice with broccoli and green onions.
Kids plate: pasta + fruit. A little teriyaki chicken on the side if they want it.

recipes.name: Smash burgers
ingredients: 1.5 lb ground beef, loosely packed into 8 balls
Salt, pepper, butter for the buns
steps: Heat a cast-iron or griddle until very hot. Toast buns in butter.
Smash each beef ball hard on the skillet. Salt and pepper. Flip after a deep crust forms.
Cheese on the second side for 30 seconds. Stack two patties if you want doubles.
Pickles and ketchup. Keep toppings on the side for picky eaters.
Kids plate: nuggets + fruit. Offer a plain slider if they ask.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Egg Bake
recipes.kidNote: kids: scramble + fruit if they skip the bake
ingredients: Salt, pepper, olive oil for the dish
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Oil a 9×13 or similar baking dish.
Whisk eggs with cottage cheese, salt, and pepper until mostly smooth.
Stir in spinach, peppers, and half the shredded cheese.
Pour into the dish, top with remaining cheese, bake 30–40 minutes until set.
Dad can eat a square with his usual peppers + extra cottage cheese. Kids: fruit on the side; scramble is still their weekday plate.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes + berries
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oats, vanilla, and salt until mostly smooth (little oat bits are fine).
Cook small pancakes on a buttered griddle over medium heat, 2–3 minutes per side.
Warm berries with a spoon of maple for a quick sauce.
Kids eat pancakes and berries. Same batter works for weekend breakfast.

recipes.name: Chicken Caprese Pasta Salad
ingredients: Olive oil, balsamic glaze, salt, pepper
steps: Boil pasta, drain, and toss with a little olive oil so it does not stick.
Fold in chicken, tomatoes, mozzarella, and torn basil.
Dress with olive oil, balsamic, salt, and pepper. Chill or serve room temp.
Kids plate: plain pasta from the same pot + fruit. Skip the balsamic if they fuss.

recipes.name: Taco Salad
ingredients: Leftover taco turkey or 3 cups rotisserie chicken
Shredded Mexican blend, salsa, sour cream
steps: Warm the meat. Chop the salad veg.
Build bowls: lettuce, meat, tomato, onion, cheese, salsa, crushed chips.
Finish with avocado, sour cream, and lime.
Kids plate: nuggets + fruit. Offer a tiny chip-and-cheese pile if they want in.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chopped Salad
recipes.kidNote: kids: fruit + pasta or cucumber coins
steps: Chop everything small so it eats like a Costco chopped salad.
Toss with lemon, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Fold in feta and olives last.
Serve as lunch or next to grilled chicken.
Kids: cucumber coins + fruit. Skip olives. Pasta leftover is still their fallback.
